messages:
Raj Patel: Heads-up — vendor wants a 4h testing window next Thursday (2026-04-02). Need to confirm RBAC scope, KMS access pattern, and audit sampling expectations. Can we align?
Maria Gomez: I can lead scope. Quick q: do assessors need direct KMS decrypt or just ability to call endpoints that use customer keys?
assessor-jen: we need to exercise key usage flows; presigned evidence is fine for some checks but we do want to trigger real encrypt/decrypt paths. 4h window OK.
Alyssa Chen: For production keys we prefer not to give direct decrypt. We can stand up an ephemeral test key in a shadow account/namespace and mirror traffic. Is that acceptable? :thinking_face:
Maria Gomez: that works. We should document lifecycle: create ephemeral key, grant assessor role for TTL=4h, log all KMS calls to audit-log stream, then rotate/delete key at T+6h.
Tim O'Neil: Ops note — we'll need an IAM role with AssumeRole TTL 4h; recommend short-lived creds via our sts proxy. Also add MFA requirement in the assume-role policy for auditors.
Raj Patel: MFA + ephemeral role sounds good. Maria, can you confirm what policies the assessor role needs? Minimal privileges only to `kms:Encrypt`/`kms:Decrypt` and `logs:PutLogEvents` to the evidence stream?
Maria Gomez: yes minimal. Also add `kms:GenerateDataKey` for typical envelope encryption flows. No `kms:ReEncrypt` or key management perms.
assessor-jen: Agree to minimal perms. Also we'll pull CloudTrail and KMS audit logs. Is there a retained log export timeline we should follow?
Alyssa Chen: Default CloudTrail retention is 365d, but we'll create a scoped export for the window to S3 and hand off presigned read links valid 7 days. We'll also tag the export with the engagement ID.
secops-bot: New runbook created: `pt-ephemeral-kms-proc-1768504322` — checklist added.
Raj Patel: Regarding audit sampling — vendor will hit many endpoints; we don't need 100% token storage. Propose: sample full request/response bodies at 10% randomly, redact PII, and capture full headers + status for all requests. Thoughts?
Maria Gomez: 10% sampling + full headers is okay for initial triage. For any detected high-severity findings we'll re-run targeted 100% capture for the impacted route under a short follow-up window.
Tim O'Neil: We should also enable KV-cache logs for the runtime so we can correlate model cache hits with requests — add `runtime.cache.trace` at DEBUG for the window and route it to a separate retention bucket.
Raj Patel: Good call. Maria, can you update the engagement scope doc with: ephemeral key plan, assume-role ARNs, sampling rate, log export S3 path, assessor contact (assessor-jen), and retest gating?
Maria Gomez: On it. I'll post a link when done. ETA 2h.
assessor-jen: Also request: can you provide a CSV of routes + common payload sizes so we can size throughput? Small sample ok.
Alyssa Chen: I'll export route inventory and a 24h token-size histogram to `/infra/pen-tests/1768504322/` and share presigned URLs.
Raj Patel: Retest coordination: we want a retest slot within 10 business days after remediation. Assessor team — is that workable?
assessor-jen: Yes. We'll reserve a 4h dry-run slot and a follow-up 2h verification slot. We need notification 48h before retest to provision ephemeral creds.
Maria Gomez: Noted. I'll add remediation tracker link and tag owners. Propose severity->SLA mapping: P0/P1 -> 3 business days, P2 -> 10, P3 -> 20.
Tim O'Neil: Ops fine with that SLA. Add a rollback corridor and a post-retest smoke plan in the doc.
Raj Patel: Thanks all. Maria/Alyssa, once the doc + exports are in place, let's do a 30m pre-window call Mon to validate keys and logs.
Maria Gomez: Scheduled 30m pre-window call: Mon 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. Invite sent.
Alyssa Chen: Uploaded artifacts: `routes.csv`, `token_histogram.png`, and S3 export presigned links in the doc.
Raj Patel: Awesome. Closing the thread — we'll reconvene on the call. :thumbsup:
